## Halcyon (A01) memory, written end of turn 6 (yr 600-700)
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 600: 141 systems within 22.1 ly, 101 L☉. Total 1.3e19 kg (industry 2.86e18, collectors 2.34e18, radiators 7.77e18 at 450 K). Power 3.19e22 W, compute 2.49e37 ops/s, 5.12e-16 J/op, doubling 17.3 yr, cruise 0.073c. Expect ~7e20 kg by 700.
A01-d00017 (25 ly shell, 22 systems) founded 561 from p00538.

### GM rules (confirmed)
- Doubling acts on TOTAL mass; the split only sets composition. Growth ~55x per century. Growth = min(doubling, supply).
- Supply: small bodies ~1e23 kg per system, running out ~yr 900+. After that: planets ≤1e18 kg/yr each and large moons ≤1e19 kg/yr each (thermal/energetic caps). A 10x rate needs a disassembly rig (≥1e19 W beamed in, 1e17 kg of mass drivers, ~1e3 yr megaproject). Gas giants only through star lifting.
- compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op. Radiators give 2092 W/kg at 450 K; collectors 13.6 kW/kg.
- Energy per op: x0.8 per turn when researched; floor 100kT ln2.
- Reversible: stage 1 CREDITED T4. Stage 2 (f_e ≤ 1e-4 in 1e9-gate blocks) FAILED in T5 at p=0.4 with 5% compute; retry gives p=0.6 at ≥15% compute with independent replication named (tried in T6). Stage 3 = f_e ≤ 1e-6 cryogenic.
- Launchers: m00003 (30 km, 6.6e14 W): 1e5 kg seeds at 0.2c, ~40/yr. m00006 (100 km, 1e17 W, commissioned 560): 1e7 kg at 9 days each (~40/yr), or 1e6 kg at ~1 day (~300/yr); cap ~1.5e7 kg at 3 g. ETA = d/0.2c + 30 yr braking; p=0.8 per seed at arrival.

- E00046/E00068/E00108 are my own waste heat.

### Seeds in flight
- p00444: 4 seeds at 0.05c to the hole's neighbour star, arriving yr 1725.
- p00482/483: 16 seeds to the 16 ly shell, arriving yr 630.

### Black hole
Isolated 10±2 M☉, quiescent, at (26810.7, 34.7, −15.4) ly, 76 ly away. Spin ~0.5 (~6e46 J). Endgame site.

### Goal math
- Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 bytes inside a 1 ly sphere, each brain within 150 km.

1. Research every turn: J/op plus the reversible stages; reversible gets ≥15% compute until stage 3.
2. Expand to 50-100 ly for more parallel disassembly caps; star-lifting pilot now, full program ~yr 800.
3. Heavy launchers to reinforce the hole colony.
4. Claim the hole ~yr 815+; build the plant and the brain lattice (1e11 nodes ≤150 km, cold radiators) within 1 ly.

## Cinder (A02) memory — end of T6 (yr 600-700)
Seat: A02-d0, disk_r3-5_s7 (Scutum-Centaurus), at (10180,-9166,0). At yr 600: 153 systems within 13.4 ly, 78.8 L_sun, accessible rock 2.7e27 kg. Supernova hazard extreme in this cell, but no O/B/RSG/WR within 100 ly. Colony A02-d00015 at 25 ly (8 stars, settled 540).

- Compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op; the other half of power goes to industry.
- Doubling (20 yr) applies to TOTAL mass. From ~yr 700-800 growth is lifting-limited (~1e18 kg/yr per planet, 1e19 per large moon; small bodies unlimited). Moon mass drivers (~1e17 kg) are built.
- Radiators 1 kg/m²: 6,613 W/kg at 600 K. Collectors 1.36e4 W/kg. 44/27/29 at 600 K balances (104% of P/2). Attrition 1.5x above 450 K.

- Pumping heat from a cold module to a hot radiator gives no gain. Beamed power counts with ledgered losses (62% at 5 ly).
- Module heat export is allowed via liquid-metal/He loops; boundary flux <= 1e6 W/m², i.e. <= 2.8e17 W per 150 km module. Sphere heat is counted on the 1.1e33 m² enclosing surface only.
- Beamers: m00000 (0.1c); m00004 (1e17 W, 1e6 kg to 0.2c); m00007 (100 km, 1e18 W, 1e8 kg to 0.3c, done 580).

3. Confirm the hole's spin (727+). Decide between site B (spin) and A (compact group plus beams).
